predeclared_thresholds.note: A2.S0 estimates are not measured decode throughput. TTFT/prefill must be measured separately in qualification.

verdict_rules.CONTINUE_DENSE_14B: sparse support/working-set/quality advantage is not credible enough to justify a sparse qualification
verdict_rules.TEST_SPARSE_BEFORE_DENSE_32B: at least one concrete sparse candidate has strong quality potential, practical active set/context, near-usable existing runtime path, and meaningful expected throughput
verdict_rules.PARALLEL_DENSE_AND_SPARSE: dense 14B and sparse solve distinct tiers with strong evidence and both benchmark costs are justified
verdict_rules.STOP_LARGE_LOCAL: neither dense nor sparse has credible quality-per-resource economics

why: Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct is a concrete coding-specialized 30.5B/3.3B-active candidate whose Q4_K_M class artifact is approximately 18.6 GB and plausibly resident on the 21 GiB model/runtime budget.
llama.cpp already has qwen3moe, CPU-MoE controls, Vulkan/SYCL MoE kernels, quantized expert compute, and selective expert transfer; no custom runtime is required for the first qualification.
Dense 32B has similar weight capacity cost but all 32B parameters are active each token and less memory margin; it remains gated until sparse qualification establishes real quality/performance.
Kimi K3 demonstrates sparse streaming mechanics but its measured 8-64 GB regime is non-interactive and does not justify a custom Kimi-style runtime on this laptop.
